{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
completed_orders['revenue_float'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (should be 0, but verify)
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_float'].mean()

# Output
mean_revenue"}
